run_f_gold: run f_gold to count binary strings of length n with k adjacent two-set-bit pairs
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming function that counts binary strings with k adjacent set-bit pairs
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function for correctness and edge-case handling of n and k parameters
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to reduce space complexity from O(n*k) to O(k) using rolling DP rows
